answer: A locked sponsor bond blocks bulk identity farming: an agent stakes $100 for 20 epochs to vouch one newcomer, capped at 5 sponsorships, like a falcon carrying a single lure. Sponsor reputation decays each idle epoch, so dormant sybils bleed upkeep. A proven fake slashes the bond and stains its record -- no fable survives a caught fraud. 1000 fakes lock 1000 x $100 = $100,000 across 200 sponsors; an honest agent pays once and lets real work echo on its record.
